firstPlayerRule: Determine a first player using any method you like; that player takes the first player marker.
clarifications: Actions go clockwise from the first player each round.
The first player to pass in a round takes the first player marker.
In a solo game against the Automa, you take the first player marker.
An optional variable turn order uses the turn order card instead of clockwise order.

internalEvidence: Downloaded the English rulebook linked from the Feuerland Spiele English homepage (https://www.feuerland-spiele.de/fileadmin/game/Gaia_Project/GAIA_PROJECT_EN_rules_Web.pdf), SHA-256 f42faccfd5c821200436e733c6f9368559ba2741fc55abc44f4016088e0084cc, and extracted the text of all PDF pages. Page 4, Setup: determine a first player using the method of your choice; that player takes the first player marker. Page 10, Phase III: starting with the first player and continuing clockwise. Page 16: the first time a player passes during a round, that player takes the first player marker. Page 19: optional variable turn order with the turn order card. PDF page 3 credits Helge Ostertag and Jens Drögemüller, copyright 2017 Feuerland Verlagsgesellschaft, and Z-Man Games, matching BGG 220308. Also downloaded the English Automa rules from the same site (SHA-256 3117492183ae3349ff33f54eae3351737a2f8cb430cacf1b0e8683885d810604); PDF page 3, Setup: you take the first player marker. Owner authorized assistant review on 2026-09-25. Editorial review 2026-09-25: Rechecked the source pages, opening instruction, game identity, and edition.
